summary.en-US: Keeps your bookmarks in sync with a YAML file at a URL you choose. One-way: the file is the source of truth, nothing is ever sent back.

description.en-US:
Maintain your bookmarks as a plain YAML file — in a git repo, on a web server, anywhere reachable over https — and Bookmarks Mirror keeps Firefox in step with it.

• One-way and read-only: the add-on only fetches the file; it never uploads or writes back.
• Owns only the roots the file names (menu, toolbar, other, mobile); the rest are never touched.
• Validates the whole file before changing anything: unknown roots, non-web urls and empty roots are refused, so a broken or truncated file never wipes your bookmarks.
• Host access is requested for the one host you configure, nothing else.

Format and rules: https://github.com/dbautz/bookmarks-mirror

version.approval_notes:
To test: open the add-on's preferences (they open on install), set the URL to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dbautz/bookmarks-mirror/main/example/bookmarks.yml, Save (grants host permission for raw.githubusercontent.com), then Sync now. The Bookmarks Toolbar is replaced by a 'Mirror test' folder and one bookmark; other roots are untouched.

The only network request is a GET of that user-configured URL. Source: background.js and options.js are esbuild bundles (unminified) of src/ plus js-yaml 4.3.2 from package-lock.json; the attached source zip rebuilds them with `npm ci && npm run build` (Node 24, npm 11), see README.md.
